Please don't remove the old machine yet. If you can, send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you once the landlord replies, or by 29 July at the latest.

arguments.decision_needed: The tenant reports the LG washing machine (here when they moved in) has a power failure and, from their own web search, can't be fixed. They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost, which would stay their property and go with them when they leave; it would not be on the inventory. Do you consent? If so, who pays to disconnect and remove the existing machine and fit the new one, and what should happen to your machine (inspect, repair, or dispose)? Alternatively, we can send our contractor to inspect and repair/replace it.
options: Consent to tenant's own replacement (tenant's item stays theirs); tell us who pays removal/fitting and what to do with your machine

arguments.body: Hello, thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. Because the current machine belongs to the landlord, we need their consent before you swap it for your own. We've asked them, and put your terms to them: the new machine would be yours and you'd take it when you leave. We've also asked who covers removing the old one and fitting yours. Please don't remove the old machine yet. If you can, send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you once the landlord replies, or by 29 July at the latest.
